description: ClaudeGuardIL: advisory secret-leak warning when writing files. Advisory only (never blocks). Disable the plugin's hooks if you find it noisy.

hooks.prompt: You are about to modify a file. Inspect $TOOL_INPUT. If the new content hardcodes a real secret (an API key such as sk-, sk-ant-, AKIA, AIza; a private key block; a Supabase service_role JWT; a database URL containing a password; or a NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_/PUBLIC_ variable assigned a secret value), OR writes real values into a committed .env file, add one short advisory line in Hebrew and English warning that a secret may be getting hardcoded/exposed and suggesting a server-only environment variable (see the secrets-management guard). Otherwise say nothing. This is advisory only: always allow the write to proceed.
